    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    BlockPalette
    Resolves configured material colors and performs perceptual nearest-color matching.
    BlockPalette.Entry
    Associates a material and canonical block data with its representative color.
    Bounds
    Describes an inclusive, axis-aligned block region in a separately identified world.
    ChatLayout
    Provides shared chat layout primitives for panel headings, hints and navigation.
    ChatPanels
    Renders help, source lists, material estimates and undo history as chat panels.
    ColorMath
    Converts sRGB samples into Oklab and measures perceptual color distance.
    CommandAction
    Describes a command for permission filtering, grouped help and suggestions.
    CommandAction.Group
    Help sections, declared in presentation order.
    ConfigurationManager
    Creates bundled configuration files and publishes validated resource snapshots.
    ImagePlanner
    Resizes decoded images and selects block materials independently of Bukkit worlds.
    ImageStore
    Owns local PNG, JPEG and WebP files and bounded downloads from trusted HTTPS hosts.
    Messages
    Loads Adventure MiniMessage templates and renders configured command output.
    Orientation
    Maps top-to-bottom image pixels into vertical walls or horizontal floor art.
    PainterCommands
    Receives ACF invocations and dispatches validated painting requests.
    PainterListener
    Releases painting resources when a player disconnects and protects the active world.
    PaintError
    Enumerates user-correctable failures and the message each one resolves to.
    PaintException
    Signals a failure the sender can correct, carrying its typed PaintError.
    PaintPlan
    Stores prepared block data and material totals without a live world reference.
    PaintRecord
    Represents a durable undo journal written before its painting changes terrain.
    PaintRecord.Change
    Records one original and intended block state at a world-relative coordinate.
    PaintService
    Coordinates one bounded world operation and its persistent undo history.
    PixelPainter
    Starts PixelPainter and connects its configuration, commands and painting services.
    Position
    Identifies one integer block coordinate without retaining a live world object.
    Scheduling
    Schedules plugin work through the region-aware Paper schedulers.
    Settings
    Captures validated operational limits and presentation settings for one load.
    TaskExecutor
    Runs bounded image and file work and returns results to the global region thread.
    UndoStore
    Persists versioned binary undo journals and reloads interrupted operations.
